ethanol-proof.l: What to work out: percent and proof (convert), proof gallons (gallons), tax, or water to add to reduce proof (reduce)
Convert: percent ethanol by volume (give this or the proof)
Gallons: unit of the volume (wine gallons or liters)
Tax: rate in dollars per proof gallon (26 U.S.C. 5001; which rate applies is the reader's to say)
Reduce: parts water at the starting proof, from Table 6 of 27 CFR 30.66
Reduce: parts water at the wanted proof, from Table 6
